messages:
Leah - RevOps: quick follow-up from today's all-hands on GTM cadence. leadership asked for a short plan on how well tighten partner-sourced forecasting and speed up ramp. can @Marta @Diego @Priya weigh in?
Marta - Partnerships: +1. proposal: 1) tag partner-influenced opps in CRM, 2) create a 1-page partner enablement playbook for AEs, 3) launch a 6-week co-sell pilot with 5 partners. goal = clearer funnel attribution and faster enablement.
Diego - Sales: practical ask: AEs need a simple checklist they can run in <10 mins. anything longer won't be used. also want a play for when partners bring pre-approved SOWs.
Priya - Product: to reduce friction, we can ship two things: a lightweight integration checklist and a demo dataset template. engineering estimate: 1 sprint for demo template + 2 days for checklist endpoint.
Leah - RevOps: for forecasting, I suggest a confidence modifier for partner-influenced deals (+/- 10%) until pilot data stabilizes. I'll add a dashboard tile showing partner pipeline vs total.
Marta - Partnerships: timeline: one-pager draft by Mon, pilot plan by Wed, partner invites out by Friday. we'll include Diego in co-sell play selection.
Diego - Sales: can we include a short objection-handling note for procurement timelines? that helps AEs close faster.
Priya - Product: we'll add a slide to the template: "procurement FAQs" with common answers.
Chris (CEO): endorse moving quickly but keep the pilot small. measure: win rate lift and reduction in time-to-close. report back after 6 weeks.
Leah - RevOps: action items: dashboard tile + confidence modifier change. ETA: 3 business days.
Marta - Partnerships: action items: draft playbook + pilot brief. ETA: Tue.
Diego - Sales: action items: provide AE checklist feedback and sample SOWs. ETA: Wed morning.
Priya - Product: action items: scope demo template + procurement FAQ slide. ETA: next week.
all-hands-bot: Slides and recording uploaded -> https://redwood.company/all-hands/1755002222. Please annotate the doc with follow-ups.
Leah - RevOps: let's do a 20-min sync Thursday 9am PT to lock PRs and outreach list. I'll send invite.
Marta - Partnerships: Sounds good.
Diego - Sales: I'll be there.
Priya - Product: +1
Chris (CEO): thank you team. keep updates concise and data-focused for the pilot review.
